title: Normalize Procedural Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize the "procedural" plugin crate (procedural/plugin/rs/lib.rs, multi-app: Procedural2dPlayApp / Procedural3dPlayApp) onto the shared framework SDK primitives and the Consistency Contract: adopt PanelKit (tree_item/tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing hand-rolled label structs and action/utility label-map functions, adopt Testkit (meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge) in the test modules, verify resource_kind declarations, confirm C1 app-struct naming, fix region markers (rename AppFactory -> Manifest, add missing endregion marker) and reorder into canonical region order (Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests).
summary:
Normalized procedural/plugin/rs/lib.rs (multi-app crate: app_2d::Procedural2dPlayApp, app_3d::Procedural3dPlayApp) onto the framework SDK primitives and the Consistency Contract.

PanelKit: deleted the local tree_item/tree_item_with_action helpers in both apps and rewrote build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree on semio_framework_plugin::{tree_item_with_action, PanelTreeBuilder}. app_3d's variant carried a per-item icon_id the shared helper doesn't model, so it kept a 3-line local tree_item_with_icon wrapper around the SDK's tree_item_with_action instead of reintroducing the full struct literal.

Terminology: replaced both hand-rolled "<Name>Labels" struct + EN/DE consts + resolver fn with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels! + resolve_labels::<T>(view_state) (kept a one-line procedural2d_labels/procedural3d_labels wrapper delegating to resolve_labels so the ~15 existing call sites needed no churn). Replaced the hand-rolled (id,en,de)->HashMap builders (procedural2d_action_labels, procedural3d_action_labels, procedural3d_utility_labels) with semio_framework_plugin::localized_label_map. Replaced both DocumentApp::app_labels() struct-literal AppLabelsOverlay constructions with the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (window_kind_label/mode_label/action_labels/utility_labels/example_labels), dropping the always-empty fields the struct literal previously spelled out by hand.

Testkit: replaced local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() in both #[cfg(test)] modules with thin delegates to semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{meta, new_app, new_app_with_registry}; rewrote the undo-redo-shaped tests (add_widget_undo_redo_round_trip, add_generation_records_an_undoable_generation_op x2, undo_redo_round_trips_flow_graph_edits, remove_widget_action_deletes_by_id_and_supports_undo) onto testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip, and both two_instances_converge_disjoint_widget_moves tests onto testkit::assert_two_instances_converge (dropped the manual MemoryBackbone::pair/load_document scaffolding). No ingest-idempotency test existed in this crate, so assert_ingest_idempotent was not applicable. Left every app-unique test (gumball drag/rotate/scale persistence, mesh bridge round-trip, rendering assertions, label-locale assertions, etc.) untouched.

resource_kind: verified both apps already declare .resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec{...}) on their AppBuilder chains (Wave-1 work) - no change needed.

C1 naming: verified app id "procedural2d-play" -> struct Procedural2dPlayApp and "procedural3d-play" -> struct Procedural3dPlayApp already match PascalCase(app id)+"App" exactly - no rename needed.

C2/C3 regions: renamed app_2d's "//#region 🔖️AppFactory" -> "//#region 🔖️Manifest"; added a missing "//#endregion 🔖️Manifest" in app_3d (the region was previously left unclosed before the Tests region - a pre-existing formatting bug); renamed app_3d's "//#region 🔖️GenerateRender" -> "//#region 🔖️Render" to match the canonical name; split app_3d's single oversized "//#region 🔖️Document" into separate "🔖️Types" (the small runtime/view/cache structs + play_view) and "🔖️DocumentHelpers" regions, mirroring app_2d's existing split. Reordered both apps' regions into the canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests order (app_3d also keeps its custom EvalCache region positioned right after Constants, and the nested GumballTransforms subregion inside DocumentHelpers - the contract only mandates ordering of the named canonical regions, not omission of app-specific extras). C6 (no app-to-app plugin deps) and C7 (no framework-side app coupling) were verified clean; no changes needed.

Bonus correctness cleanup found while relocating code for the region split: app_3d defined two byte-for-byte identical ActionDescriptor-building functions, procedural_action and procedural3d_action (the second was left un-regioned, floating between CommandLabels and Manifest). Deduped to the single procedural_action and updated its two call sites (procedural3d_lod_measure, window_measures' world3d_sun_measures call).

Verification: cargo check could not complete - the shared build directory was lock-contended by ~15 other concurrent sessions' cargo processes the entire time (confirmed via `ps aux`, matching the documented repo-wide contention); a check was started, waited on briefly, still blocked, and was killed rather than waited on indefinitely, per policy. In its place: (1) rustfmt --check on the file confirmed no parse errors (only pre-existing wide-line style diffs - diff count actually dropped from 202 to 100 blocks vs the pre-edit backup, i.e. strictly more rustfmt-conformant than before); (2) whole-file brace/paren/bracket counts balance exactly (653/653, 2780/2780, 205/205); (3) every "//#region 🔖️X" has a matching "//#endregion 🔖️X" (counts equal per name); (4) diffed every `fn`, `struct`, and `const` identifier against a byte-for-byte pre-edit backup snapshot (kept in this ticket folder as lib.rs.pre-edit-backup) - the only deltas are the ones I made intentionally (removed tree_item/tree_item_with_action locals, renamed tree_item_with_action->tree_item_with_icon in app_3d, removed duplicate procedural3d_action, removed the two PROCEDURAL*_LABELS_NATIVE_* consts now generated by the app_labels! macro); test function count is unchanged at 39 in both before/after; (5) cross-checked every `labels.<field>` usage against each Procedural{2d,3d}Labels struct's field list - zero mismatches. I did NOT get a compiler-confirmed green build; that is deferred to the orchestrator's final full workspace check per the verification policy.

Nothing needed to be expressed outside existing SDK primitives - PanelTreeBuilder, tree_item_with_action, app_labels!/resolve_labels, localized_label_map, AppLabelsOverlayExt, and testkit::{meta,new_app,new_app_with_registry,assert_undo_redo_round_trip,assert_two_instances_converge} all covered this crate's needs directly. The one non-generic case (per-item icon_id in tree items) was handled with a 3-line wrapper around the SDK helper rather than a full local reimplementation, which seems like the right shape and not something the SDK needs to grow.
